Make store_integrity findings gate fsck exit status to 1, keep unknown_event_types as informational (no status change), and map Git/ref scan failures to exit 2 with RebarError(returncode=2).

Update all consumers in one shippable change: CLI (canonical bridge fsck and compatibility bridge-fsck), public library rebar.bridge_fsck(), generated TypedDict/MCP model, JSON schema, MCP tool description, probe script, tests, and release notes.
Remove stale-SYNC machinery including _STALE_THRESHOLD_NS, _NS_THRESHOLD, _to_ns, --now-ts flag, and SYNC-only scan arms and test fixtures.
